note: Frozen before building or reading any seventh-cohort micro rows. micro_common already lists seventh in SPLITS; combat_common.COHORTS gained seventh from the coordinator. Seventh is scored once with these unchanged files.

rules.basic target: min (hp + shield, id) among visible enemies in basic range at the attack before-state; no focus, previous-target, retaliation or stun term
rules.Cassi stun target: exclude Marcella and positive-timer stuns, max Strength (CONTINUATION); no ally-target or yet-to-act term
rules.Marcella reset-stun: second basic hits the same target as the first
rules.Prism slot choice: standing still with an enemy within 4: slot 0 if ready, else slot 1; walking: no cast
rules.Prism ground centre: maximise visible enemies within 1 of the centre
rules.Ren stun when: ready, enemy within 4: cast iff standing still
rules.ranged spacing: walking with a melee enemy within 2: end >= 3 from every melee enemy; walking in range: max distance (cap 3) to the nearest melee enemy
rules.declines (walking farther): min danger tile among farther tiles
rules.melee engage tile: adjacent to the weakest reachable enemy
rules.tile tie-break: bush preferred among tiles at the same distance class (general pathing, not contact-specific)
rules.kills: the first Fish actor in turn order with the kill in reach takes it; no holding for a teammate
